questions.qtext: Kathy is a repair technician for a phone company. Each week, she receives a batch of phones that need repairs. The number of phones that she has left to fix at the end of each day can be estimated with the equation $P=108-23 d$, where $P$ is the number of phones left and $d$ is the number of days she has worked that week. What is the meaning of the value $108$ in this equation?

options.text: Kathy will complete the repairs within $108$ days.
Kathy starts each week with $108$ phones to fix.
Kathy repairs phones at a rate of $108$ per hour.
Kathy repairs phones at a rate of $108$ per day.

questions.solution:
Answer: B, D

Source solution 1 (score: 0)
kathy starts each week with 108 phones and at the end of the day she fixes 23 phones...

Source solution 2 (score: 0)
$\textbf{\textcolor{green}{Answer: B}}$

$\text{Equation: P = 108 − 23d}$

Where, $108 =$ The initial number of phones Kathy has to repair at the beginning of the week

$23 =$ The number of phones Kathy repairs each day.
